reason: Executes the deterministic Firefox desktop and mobile browser journeys.
maintenance: The exact release is pinned to the Playwright driver in the locked Nixpkgs input; upgrades are reviewed and tested together.
provenance: This is the official Microsoft Playwright test runner, resolved to the exact Bun lockfile artifact and integrity above.
alternatives: The existing Bun test runner cannot drive real browsers; a local browser harness would duplicate Playwright's lifecycle, isolation, and diagnostics.
